description: This PHP class 'Migration' defines a database schema migration script for version 5.5.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating and updating tables, inserting localization strings, configuring modules and permissions, and managing workflow states related to the Claims module.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: This class implements a database migration for version 5.5.0 of OrangeHRM, handling schema updates, localization, permissions, module configuration, and workflow state setup.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps including schema creation, data insertion, localization updates, permission setup, and workflow configuration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, '5.5.0'.

methods.name: modifyClaimTables
methods.description: Alters existing claim-related tables to update character sets and column definitions to suit the new schema requirements.

methods.name: modifyClaimRequestCurrencyToForeignKey
methods.description: Changes the 'currency' field in 'ohrm_claim_request' to be a foreign key referencing currency types.

methods.name: changeClaimExpenseTypeTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts the 'status' field in 'ohrm_expense_type' to a boolean type.

methods.name: changeClaimEventTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts the 'status' field in 'ohrm_claim_event' to a boolean type.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Sets or updates the version number of language strings to the current migration version.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for managing language strings.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Inserts a new menu item into the system with specified parameters.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a menu item by title and parent ID.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a screen by name.

methods.name: checkClaimExists
methods.description: Checks if a claim menu item already exists in the system.

methods.name: cleanClaimScreens
methods.description: Deletes outdated or conflicting claim-related screens.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a workflow state into the workflow state machine table.

methods.name: deleteClaimWorkflowStates
methods.description: Removes existing claim workflow states before inserting new ones.

methods.name: removeMarketplaceTables
methods.description: Drops marketplace-related tables if they exist.

methods.name: updateI18nGroups
methods.description: Updates internationalization group associations for language strings.

methods.name: correctingCurrencyIdColumnInconsistencies
methods.description: Corrects currency ID column inconsistencies in the database (referenced from another migration).
